modules.responsibility: 输入尺寸、HTTP 及内容边界
WAV 解包、量化和 PCM 布局
加窗、傅里叶变换和谱图聚合
选区、跨窗重建、信号计量和导出
单喇叭折叠、频带电平比较、相消挽回和半码量化
频谱选区交互和双版本对听

workflows.name: 录音识别
workflows.success: 保留声道数、采样率和帧数
workflows.failure: 不合规 PCM 格式拒绝
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=inspect(sample); if(a.channels!==2||a.rate!==16000||a.frames!==48000)process.exit(1); console.log(a.frames);'
steps: 从 POST inspect 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，保留声道数、采样率和帧数

workflows.name: 谱图计算
workflows.success: 窗长变化使真实频格宽度变化
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=inspect({...sample,size:1024}); if(a.spectrum.values[0].length!==513||a.spectrum.binHz!==15.625)process.exit(1); console.log(a.spectrum.binHz);'
steps: 从 POST inspect 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，窗长变化使真实频格宽度变化

workflows.name: 频带衰减
workflows.success: 污染选区附近频带能量下降
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=inspect(sample); const b=repair({...sample,regions:[sample.region]}); const k=Math.round(1600/a.spectrum.binHz); if(b.spectrum.values[90][k]>=a.spectrum.values[90][k]-15)process.exit(1); console.log(b.editedWindows);'
steps: 从 POST repair 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，污染选区附近频带能量下降

workflows.name: 旁路重建
workflows.success: 无选区的输出逐帧等价
workflows.failure: 不完整 RIFF 数据拒绝
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=repair({...sample,regions:[]}); if(a.wav!==sample.wav||a.editedWindows)process.exit(1); console.log(a.wav.length);'
steps: 从 POST repair 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，无选区的输出逐帧等价

workflows.name: 量测和 PCM 输出
workflows.success: 保持源帧数并给出逐声道差值
workflows.failure: 超过时长或选区数量限制拒绝
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=repair({...sample,regions:[sample.region]}); const b=inspect(a); if(b.frames!==48000||a.metrics.length!==2||!a.metrics.every(c=>c.differenceRms>0))process.exit(1); console.log(a.metrics);'
steps: 从 POST repair 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，保持源帧数并给出逐声道差值

workflows.name: 折叠电平比较
workflows.success: 同一频率刻度给出各频带合计与折叠电平及状态
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect} from "./server/fold/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/fold/demo.mjs"; const d=demo(); const a=inspect({wav:d.wav,start:d.circle.start,end:d.circle.end}); const s=a.bands.map(b=>b.status); if(!["cancel","single","empty","normal"].every(x=>s.includes(x)))process.exit(1); console.log(s.join(","));'
steps: 从 POST inspect 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，低于 8 码标无有效内容，单侧有声不标相消

workflows.name: 相消频带挽回
workflows.success: 成品各勾选带均方根为原合计值的 85–115%
workflows.failure: 非相消频带的勾选拒绝
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,rescue} from "./server/fold/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/fold/demo.mjs"; const d=demo(); const a=inspect({wav:d.wav,start:d.circle.start,end:d.circle.end}); const i=a.bands.findIndex(b=>b.status==="cancel"); const r=rescue({wav:d.wav,start:d.circle.start,end:d.circle.end,bands:[i]}); if(!r.verify.every(v=>v.ratio>=0.85&&v.ratio<=1.15)||r.saturation)process.exit(1); console.log(r.verify[0].ratio);'
steps: 从 POST rescue 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，只处理圈内勾选频带并给出逐带核验

workflows.name: 等长单声道输出
workflows.success: 普通折叠与成品共用原采样率等长单声道 PCM16
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,fold} from "./server/fold/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/fold/demo.mjs"; import {encode} from "./server/audio/encode.mjs"; const mono=encode({tracks:[new Float64Array(48000)],rate:16000,frames:48000}).toString("base64"); let ok=0; try{inspect({wav:mono,start:0,end:1})}catch(e){ok=e.message.includes("单声道")?1:0} const d=demo(); const f=fold({wav:d.wav}); if(!ok||!f.wav)process.exit(1); console.log(f.wav.length);'
steps: 从 POST fold 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，逐帧取左右平均并按半码远离零取整
